summary: This video breaks down the author's strategy for selecting gear pieces to store in the Cross-Boundary Storage Vault when transitioning into the next season. The focus is on preserving top-tier crafted equipment and high-stat mythic gear that will convert into Precise Carnage sets in S9. Gear choices are tailored to supply key damage dealers in the Temporal Vortex Dauntless team as well as preparing for an expected Aura meta resurgence. The author also explains stat priorities for specific hero builds, such as balancing Crit Rate and Crit Damage.

meta_changes: Realm of Fallen Souls gear sets from S8 will automatically convert to Precise Carnage gear sets upon entering S9.
Aura teams are anticipated to receive a substantial power boost in S9 with the arrival of Holfast and targeted boss mechanics.
tips: Prioritize saving crafted gear items into the Vault as they retain optimal sub-stats across seasons.
Store gear targeting your primary boss-killing team (such as Dauntless for Temporal Vortex) to hit high scores immediately in the new season.
Reserve gear with high Crit Damage sub-stats for heroes that receive bonus Crit Rate from external artifacts or abilities.
